lines.speaker: customer_vp_engineering
lines.text: We are evaluating a hosted inference endpoint for a support agent that selects tools to look up, update, search, or escalate tickets.

lines.speaker: customer_vp_engineering
lines.text: For the first proof point, at least 95% of the approved 200 support cases must choose the exact support tool. We need to inspect why any case is wrong.

lines.speaker: vendor_solutions_engineer
lines.text: We will freeze the fixture, record the exact rule, and provide the raw case-level evidence and calculation with the final recommendation.
